story.title: In Memory of My Wife, Elise Cawley, with Thanks for 36 Wonderful Years

draft:
Stephen Wolfram's tribute to his late wife Elise Cawley is a poignant reminder of the human side of tech. 
I found it striking how he weaves together personal anecdotes with reflections on their life together. 
His writing highlights the importance of balance between work and personal life. 
What role do you think personal relationships play in shaping our approach to work and technology?
#tech #AI #wolfram
